name: Dia sam
summary: Địa sâm is a Cần Giờ specialty in Dân Việt, fresh or dried. Fresh, the story says, is grilled, stir-fried, fried, or cooked as porridge. Dried, it is used to sweeten a cooking liquid. It is naturally sweet, and the story calls the cooking simple. It does not say whether địa sâm is a root or an animal.
origin: Can Gio. Dân Việt, 28 Apr 2024. The story does not name the species.
howToEat: Use it fresh in one of the four cooks, or dried to sweeten a liquid. The species was not printed.
